note: The form of .agents/policies/failure.md that the conductor reads. The two must agree on every class and route, and `harness validate` checks that they do. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the failure's evidence, in this order.

done.note: Next workflow step. Evidence is attached or the step is not done.

failed.note: Route by failure class. The retry budget decrements.

blocked.note: Record the blocker where the work is tracked, escalate to whoever holds it, stop. Do not work around it.

uncertain.note: Route to a verifying role, or to a person if no evidence would settle it. Never promote.

needs_review.note: Route to a reviewer who did not author the work.

classes.why: The test may be right. Read it before changing it.
Guessing at code you do not know is how interfaces break.
Measure against a baseline; an opinion is not a measurement.
"Flaky" is a hypothesis. Instrument it before calling it one.

classes.observed: Benchmark gain with no holdout gain
classes.why: That is what gaming a metric looks like.
Never fall back to a weaker check without saying so.
